purpose: Derive one public line for each active repository from the distinction it preserves, the collapse it refuses, and the responsibility it passes forward.
definition: A repository thought is the shortest sentence that remains true even when the preferred hypothesis fails.
construction_rules: Describe an epistemic operation rather than only a taxon, topic, method or favorable result.
Respect the repository claim ceiling and source ownership.
Sibling repositories must not receive interchangeable lines.
Negative, bounded, unavailable, censored and set-valued outcomes remain valid scientific objects.
A superseded repository identity may remain in provenance but not as an active thought.

series_logic.azami: recover variation before averaging, then separate recurrence from exact historical localization
series_logic.flower: place variation in space, separate visible and molecular identity through time, then return the acquired coordinates to the original polymorphic system
series_logic.island: unpack the island label into context, conditional response and trait-specific divergence
series_logic.observation: preserve a revisitable primary record, preserve unresolved evidence, define post-entry judgment semantics, then audit what never entered the record
series_logic.interaction: shared cue conflict -> second-coordinate escape -> mechanism allocation boundary
series_logic.mechanism_resolution: state what the current observation map cannot identify, then choose a next observation that separates the remaining mechanisms
series_logic.niche_to_survey: admit representation -> expose hidden thickness -> propagate reachability/world uncertainty -> justify bounded field observation
series_logic.theory: define safe forgetting, expose future/history/mechanism obligations, license reports from evidence, test dynamic sufficiency and warning, then connect without centralizing ownership

thoughts.line: 平均は、種を代表するほど、種の内側を消す。
thoughts.move: recover within-taxon continuous variation before taxon-level compression
thoughts.preserves: individual phenotype structure and trait-specific geography
thoughts.refuses: taxon mean as the phenotype itself

thoughts.line: 反復は数えられても、起点は一つに定まらない。
thoughts.move: separate robust recurrence bounds from transition localization
thoughts.preserves: minimum recurrence and historical uncertainty
thoughts.refuses: minimum changes as independent origin, convergence or adaptation

thoughts.line: 同じ変異が、ある場所では共存し、別の場所では地図になる。
thoughts.move: treat local coexistence and geographic differentiation as different spatial organizations
thoughts.preserves: where variation is organized
thoughts.refuses: present geography as one maintenance mechanism or evolutionary history

thoughts.line: 同じ色は、同じ分子の道を丸ごと必要としない。
thoughts.move: separate visible state, molecular implementation and event identity
thoughts.preserves: modular recurrence and event uncertainty
thoughts.refuses: visible similarity as complete molecular or historical identity

thoughts.line: 一つの花色多型を畳めなかったことが、すべての座標を開いた。
thoughts.move: keep the original polymorphism unresolved enough to branch into space, history, phenotype resolution, observation and identification, then return those coordinates to the origin
thoughts.preserves: the unresolved origin and the return loop
thoughts.refuses: hotarubukuro as merely a later empirical example or third flower chapter

thoughts.line: 島という一語が、異なる過程を一つの症候群に畳む。
thoughts.move: separate observation process and context-dependent response structure
thoughts.preserves: regional response differences and unresolved regions
thoughts.refuses: island distance as pure isolation treatment and no record as trait zero

thoughts.line: 同じ攪乱でも、出発点と出会いが未来の枝を選ぶ。
thoughts.move: condition one perturbation on starting state and realized community
thoughts.preserves: starting-position geometry and community-conditioned branching
thoughts.refuses: one universal monotonic post-perturbation response

thoughts.line: 花は島で一方向に変わらず、形質ごとにほどける。
thoughts.move: decompose one flower into independently varying phenotype axes
thoughts.preserves: trait-specific island divergence
thoughts.refuses: one island-syndrome score or Pst as selection evidence

thoughts.line: 観測は、判断より先に、戻れる記録でなければならない。
thoughts.move: separate the primary record from machine candidate decisions
thoughts.preserves: fixed-effort records and later reinspection
thoughts.refuses: candidate capture as biological truth

thoughts.line: 未決定は、答えの欠如ではなく、証拠の保存である。
thoughts.move: retain target, nuisance, observability and absence evidence as non-complementary
thoughts.preserves: different reasons for unresolved evidence
thoughts.refuses: low target support as certified absence or nuisance truth

thoughts.line: 観測が与えるのは答えではなく、答えてよい範囲である。
thoughts.move: convert an entered observation record into explicit downstream judgment entitlement
thoughts.preserves: B/T/N/U and reason-preserving abstention
thoughts.refuses: binary coarsening or a raw threshold as transferable ecological judgment

thoughts.line: 記録されなかったことは、起きなかったことではない。
thoughts.move: define a gate-independent exposure universe before defining nondetection and separate acquisition, gate and record-entry loss
thoughts.preserves: master exposure denominator, shadow entries and unresolved reference truth
thoughts.refuses: event log as its own denominator or no record as no event

thoughts.line: 共有された合図では、魅力は味方だけに届かない。
thoughts.move: place pollinator benefit and antagonist cost on the same shared-cue coordinate
thoughts.preserves: multiple evolutionary exits from one signal conflict
thoughts.refuses: attraction as a pure benefit or sparse evidence as absence of conflict

thoughts.line: 逃げ道が開いても、何が開けたかは一つに定まらない。
thoughts.move: separate outcome-level second-coordinate escape from allocation among relief, interference and joint cost
thoughts.preserves: escape sign plus compatible mechanism allocations
thoughts.refuses: total interaction as a full mechanism explanation

thoughts.line: 機構に近い証拠ほど、機構を一つにするとは限らない。
thoughts.move: separate mechanistic proximity from identification strength
thoughts.preserves: point, partial and non-identification plus calibration transport limits
thoughts.refuses: biologically direct measurement as automatic mechanism identification

thoughts.line: 見えない原因を当てず、残る原因を分ける観測を選ぶ。
thoughts.move: retain an admissible mechanism region and choose an estimable next observation by information about residual mechanism identity
thoughts.preserves: A_epsilon, residual entropy, observation information value and sequential stopping
thoughts.refuses: modal mechanism as true cause or unverified candidate value as validated information

thoughts.line: 環境は、入れただけでは niche にならない。
thoughts.move: require sealed out-of-sample admission before an environmental dimension earns a place in the representation
thoughts.preserves: candidate universe, non-promotion and blocked follow-on
thoughts.refuses: ecological plausibility as a validated universal driver

thoughts.line: 地図は、niche を薄くする。
thoughts.move: open S(x,y) into additional z/t axes and measure information left after horizontal position is known
thoughts.preserves: projection-loss geometry and source precision
thoughts.refuses: flat support area as full ecological state-space capacity

thoughts.line: 住める場所と、辿り着ける場所は違う。
thoughts.move: separate local possibility, reachability, distributional realizability and historical truth
thoughts.preserves: compatible worlds and exact update identity
thoughts.refuses: local support as realized distribution or compatible world as true history

thoughts.line: 予測の終点は、次の観測の入口になる。
thoughts.move: turn bounded support evidence into justified candidate survey patches
thoughts.preserves: validated Japanese patch claim and failed external promotion
thoughts.refuses: candidate patch as occupancy, exact site or route optimum

thoughts.line: 状態とは、世界そのものではなく、責任をもって忘れた世界である。
thoughts.move: construct state as the coarsest contract-adequate quotient
thoughts.preserves: differences required by future, history, mechanism, evidence and report responsibility
thoughts.refuses: snapshot or intrinsic natural classification as unconditional state

thoughts.line: 未来にできることが増えると、現在に残すべき差も増える。
thoughts.move: let a larger future grammar refine present representational obligation
thoughts.preserves: future-response distinctions made relevant by newly legal actions
thoughts.refuses: same present description as sufficient under every future grammar

thoughts.line: 同じ現在でも、どこから来たかが意味を変える。
thoughts.move: restore the minimum source/history context required after replacement
thoughts.preserves: transportable law, failed merge, least repair and necessary history
thoughts.refuses: same present form as same inherited meaning

thoughts.line: 姿が同じでも、未来への応答が違えば、同じ状態ではない。
thoughts.move: retain mechanism distinctions only when they can change contract-relevant future response
thoughts.preserves: common, typed and set-valued laws
thoughts.refuses: preserving every mechanism difference or forgetting them all

thoughts.line: 必要な差、見えた差、言ってよい差は一致しない。
thoughts.move: separate required state, identified state and reportable target
thoughts.preserves: evidence-compatible ambiguity and false-resolution risk
thoughts.refuses: required distinction as automatically observed or reportable

thoughts.line: 同じ周辺量でも、重なり方が次の遷移を変える。
thoughts.move: separate equality of marginals from equality of cross-layer alignment
thoughts.preserves: configuration information that changes the next transition
thoughts.refuses: same marginals as the same dynamic state

thoughts.line: 先に起きることは、先を当てられることではない。
thoughts.move: separate within-event ordering from full-denominator predictive discrimination
thoughts.preserves: replicated ordering, zero specificity and state-conditional portability
thoughts.refuses: pre-loss change as warning validity by itself

thoughts.line: 接続しても、証拠の住所は移さない。
thoughts.move: connect typed research objects while leaving primary ownership distributed
thoughts.preserves: non-identity among Reality, ModelWorld, State, Evidence and Report plus provenance
thoughts.refuses: registry, synthesis or centrality as ownership of source evidence or theorem

superseded.reason: the former theory-method hinge is now split into identification-boundary theory and observation-design methodology
